title: How can AI make your direct mail campaigns smarter?
summary: 99% of leaders use AI in direct mail, but high-ROI teams use it differently. Here's where AI actually makes an impact, backed by the State of Direct Mail 2026 report.
body_text: How can AI make your direct mail campaigns smarter? 99% of marketing and operations leaders now use AI or automation in their direct mail programs, according to Lob's State of Direct Mail Business Insights 2026 report . But using AI and using it effectively are two different things. Here’s how teams are applying AI to direct mail for real impact. ‍ AI for personalized direct mail at scale Personalization has moved beyond brands simply adding a name to a mailer, to true one-to-one direct mail experiences that would never be practical to create manually at scale. AI makes it possible to analyze customer data across channels and use those signals to determine what message to send, to whom, and when. High-ROI teams use AI to integrate behavioral data into their personalization – purchase history, engagement patterns, lifecycle stage – producing mail that feels relevant rather than generic. ‍ AI-powered targeting and timing Predictive models analyze customer data to decide who to target, when to send , and how often. 84% of companies now use predictive models in their direct mail programs, and 93% say they lift conversions. That kind of targeting reduces waste. Instead of mailing everyone on a list and hoping for the best, AI helps identify which recipients are most likely to respond and when they're most likely to act. ‍ Creative decisions with AI Companies are increasingly using AI to guide creative choices like which offer to feature, image to use, or headline to test. When connected to performance data, AI tools can surface patterns that human analysis might miss and inform future creative decisions with evidence rather than instinct. ‍ Using AI for attribution and measurement Attribution in direct mail has historically been difficult. AI helps by connecting mail delivery data to downstream customer behavior, building a clearer picture of what a campaign actually drove. High-ROI teams are more than three times as likely to integrate analytics into their programs, giving them a fuller view of performance across channels. ‍ Delivery accuracy and logistics High-ROI teams also apply AI to improve delivery accuracy, using data to optimize routing, entry points, and timing so mail arrives when it's supposed to. Only 39% of leaders currently have full real-time visibility into delivery status, and AI-driven logistics intelligence is one of the ways that gap is closing. ‍

title: Prioritizing Convenience: The Key to Pharmacy Success
summary: How can you make your pharmacy a haven of convenience? Let's explore some practical strategies.
body_text: For today’s busy patients, convenience isn't just a perk – it's an expectation. Understanding and prioritizing patient convenience can be the key to fostering loyalty, attracting new patients, and ultimately, boosting your bottom line. It’s about more than just filling prescriptions; it’s about creating a seamless and positive experience at every touchpoint. ‍ So, how can you make your pharmacy a haven of convenience? Let's explore some practical strategies. ‍ Embrace Digital Solutions ‍ Online Refills and Mobile Apps: This is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. Allow patients to easily request refills online or through a user-friendly mobile app, like Nimble , saving them time and phone calls. Digital Communication: Implement secure text or email notifications for refill reminders, order status updates, and appointment confirmations. This keeps patients informed without requiring them to initiate contact. Telepharmacy Options: Explore the possibility of offering virtual consultations for medication reviews or minor health concerns, which is especially beneficial for patients with mobility issues or those in remote areas. ‍ Streamline In-Store Processes ‍ Efficient Workflow: Analyze your current dispensing process to identify bottlenecks. Implement strategies like pre-packaging common medications, utilizing technology for faster dispensing, and clearly marking different service areas. Express Pickup Options: Consider offering designated express lanes for simple refills or pre-filled orders, minimizing wait times for those in a hurry. Extended Hours and Weekend Availability: Evaluate the needs of your community and consider extending your operating hours or offering weekend services to accommodate busy schedules. ‍ Go the Extra Mile ‍ Medication Synchronization: Offer programs that allow patients with multiple prescriptions to pick them all up on the same day each month, simplifying their medication management. Clear Communication and Patient Education: Ensure your staff is well-trained to answer questions efficiently and provide clear instructions. Offer easy-to-understand resources on medication usage and potential side effects. Personalized Service: Remember the human touch. Train your staff to greet patients warmly, address them by name, and build rapport. A friendly and helpful interaction can significantly enhance the overall experience. ‍ By focusing on these strategies, you can transform your pharmacy into a go-to destination for patients seeking not only quality healthcare but also unparalleled convenience. Investing in making your patients' lives easier will undoubtedly translate into increased patient satisfaction, loyalty, and ultimately, a thriving pharmacy.
